text:
alex: Heads-up — planning an immutable-layer "stapling" rollout for our runtime base images. Goal: signed, stapled layers (cosign attestation + KMS backing) + audit logs. Need to coordinate RBAC for the signer, KMS rotation window, vuln triage for any failing images, and an incident fallback plan. Thinking a Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC window. Anyone blocked?

munira: SGTM. Quick Q: by stapling you mean attaching attestations to the image manifest (not mutating layers), right? :thinking_face:

alex: right — attestations attached to manifests via cosign, not rewriting layers. We want to ensure runtime enforcers (policy agents) can validate stapled attestations at pull time.

priya: I can own RBAC for the signer SA. We'll need a dedicated KMS key with a narrow IAM binding. Also want audit log routing to the security audit project.

samir: I'll handle the runtime side — add a validation webhook in the cluster that rejects images without a valid attestation. Need the exact cosign public key format for the policy.

alex: rough action items: 1) Munira + Priya: signer SA RBAC + KMS key policy. 2) Samir: webhook + fallback to allowlist during cutover. 3) Alex: rollout coord + incident runbook + calendar invite.

priya: For RBAC I propose: signer SA in infra-project, only allow kms.cryptoSign on the specific key, and no broad storage roles. Example IAM: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` bound to `serviceAccount:signer@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

munira: +1. We'll also add an audit sink filter for cosign operations: `resource.type="container" AND protoPayload.methodName:"SignBlob"` so we get tamper visibility.

samir: Implementation detail: webhook will call the verification service which uses `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer-key`. During rotation we need a grace period where both old and new keys verify.

alex: Exactly. KMS rotation plan: schedule rotation Day 0 (create new key), Day 1-3 grace where signer writes with new key and verifier accepts both, Day 4 cut permanent. We need <48h notice to SRE for capacity.

priya: One more constraint: our signing tool runs in GCF with short-lived SA tokens. We must ensure the signer has limited lifetime credentials and no broad access to image registries.

munira: Vulnerability triage: if an image fails attestation signature check but passes CVE scan, what do we do? My proposal: block promote to prod, flag in vuln-triage channel, and run manual root-cause.

samir: Agreed. Also add an automated fallback policy: if >5% of pulls in 15m fail validation, flip to allowlist-only for 30m and page oncall. That prevents user-visible outages.

alex: Good. Priya/Munira — can you draft the signer RBAC YAML and KMS IAM snippet? Use minimal scope. Sample we can iterate on:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: image-signer
  namespace: infra
---
# IAM binding (conceptual)
# roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> serviceAccount:infra:image-signer@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

priya: Will do. I’ll ping once I open the PR. Expect a draft in ~3h.

munira: I'll add the audit sink config and a short playbook for searching for signature-related anomalies.

devops-bot: deploy-checklist created: checklist/immutable-layer-staple/2149004444. Assigned: priya, munira, samir, alex.

samir: I'll prototype the webhook and run it in staging tomorrow. Need the cosign verifier container image name to pin. Recommend `gcr.io/redwood/cosign-verifier:stable-2026-03`.

security-bot: Note: any change to signer SA permissions requires 2 approvers from Eng-Security and Eng-Infra. Please tag reviewers in PR.

alex: Thanks — let's keep the cutover light. If nobody raises blockers by EOD my calendar invite goes out for Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC and I'll open the rollout PR with the runbook attached.

priya: No blockers from infra side. Will include IAM snippet and a short rollback note (revoke signer key and fall back to allowlist).

munira: I'll prepare a short incident-runbook section: detection queries, how to force-ignore a broken signature, and postmortem checklist.

alex: Perfect. If anything urgent, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
